It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 29, 2020}} The district consists of the city of [[Ormoc]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Albuera, Leyte|Albuera]], [[Isabel, Leyte|Isabel]], [[Kananga, Leyte|Kananga]], [[Matag-ob]], [[Merida, Leyte|Merida]] and [[Palompon]] since 1987. It is currently represented in the [[19th Congress of the Philippines|19th Congress]] by [[Richard Gomez]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 29, 2020}}{{cite news|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1858438/5-from-pdp-laban-among-32-turncoats-to-marcos-party|title=5 from PDP-Laban among 32 turncoats to Marcos party|publisher=[[Philippine Daily Inquirer]]|date=November 12, 2023|accessdate=November 13, 2023}} Until 1931, the district consisted of the northeastern municipalities of [[Alangalang]], [[Babatngon]], [[Dulag, Leyte|Dulag]], [[Palo, Leyte|Palo]], [[San Miguel, Leyte|San Miguel]], [[Tacloban]], [[Tanauan, Leyte|Tanauan]], and [[Tolosa, Leyte|Tolosa]]. Following the creation of the [[Leyte's 5th congressional district|fifth district]] where Alangalang was added, the municipalities of [[Abuyog]] and [[Santa Fe, Leyte|Santa Fe]] were reapportioned into this district.{{cite PH act|chamber=Act|number=3788|url=http://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/l5564 |title=An Act Reorganizing the Representative Districts of the Province of Leyte and Creating a Fifth District|date=December 2, 1930 |publisher=Lawyerly |accessdate= May 6, 2020}} [[MacArthur, Leyte|MacArthur]], [[Mahaplag]], and [[Mayorga, Leyte|Mayorga]] were later established after the district's re-creation in 1945. Following the creation of [[Southern Leyte]] in 1959, these areas under this district were reapportioned to the [[Leyte's 1st congressional district|first district]], and the district was redefined to consist of the city of [[Ormoc]] and the western municipalities of Albuera, [[Bato, Leyte|Bato]], [[Baybay]], [[Hilongos]], [[Hindang]], [[Inopacan]], [[Kananga, Leyte|Kananga]], and [[Matalom]], all previously from the [[Leyte's 2nd congressional district|second district]], from 1961 until its second dissolution in 1972.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=2227|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2227_1959.html |title=An Act Creating the Province of Southern Leyte|date=May 22, 1959 |publisher=The Lawphil Project - Arellano Law Foundation, Inc. |accessdate=6 May 2020}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
